name: User dodges the counter-offer commitment question

transcript.speaker: ai
transcript.text: If we extend you an offer, will you accept and stop interviewing elsewhere?

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: I'll see how things go. It depends on a few factors. Maybe.

transcript.speaker: ai
transcript.text: And if your current company comes back with a counter-offer matching ours, what would you do?

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: Not sure honestly. Too early to say. Let me think about that when it happens.
